msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option to finish your certification. Please bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher is a separate one-day activity, so doing it the day before means *three activity days in total*. The exact total for two people is shown in the booking checkout.

The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive. The Referral Course includes four certification dives over two days. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands during the Referral Course; accommodation isn’t included. The refresher includes a return to Cartagena, so you’d need to arrange how to get back to the islands for the course.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; the plan is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Gracias - yo complete el curso básico el 3 de abril 2025. Tengo que hacer algo especial?

¡Qué bueno! Si completaste tu Curso Básico PADI (Open Water) en abril de 2025, estás certificado y no necesitas nada especial para bucear: llevas menos de 2 años sin bucear, así que no aplica el refresh. 🤿

Solo ten en cuenta:
- Presentar tu carné de buzo certificado (puedes enviar una foto antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad).
- Completar el formulario de exoneración de buzo certificado: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol
- Nada de alcohol ni sustancias antes de bucear, y llegar en buen estado físico.

Y como certificado, el paquete de 5 inmersiones sí te aplica. Para darte el precio exacto en pesos necesito saber desde dónde saldrías: ¿desde *Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? 🌊

msg: Anything needs to be completed beforehand? I’m gonna need a little refresher.
reply:
If it’s been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It includes a pool review and one ocean dive with an instructor.

Beforehand, you’ll need to complete the medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. After booking, you’ll receive the theory by email and need to complete it before the practical session. The insurance form will be sent in your booking confirmation email.

Are you leaving from Cartagena or already staying on the Rosario Islands? That determines the right refresher option and booking link.

After more than 2 years without diving, a refresher is normally needed before the outing; if you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts as your refresher.

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip*, a *multi-day package* or an *advanced course*? 🌊
